exposure: Weight class according to gestational age
cohort: 392 pregnant women with gestational diabetes mellitus attending a public maternity hospital in the south of Brazil
finding: History of prior cesarean section, first pregnancy, and obesity were associated with an increased cesarean delivery rate in women with gestational diabetes mellitus.
mod_finding: The study found that the chance of cesarean delivery was greater in pregnant women who were obese, primigravida, or had a previous cesarean delivery.
